newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia stocks end higher, spurred on by Ganadero.
newsitem.headline: Colombia stocks end higher, spurred on by Ganadero.

text.p: Colombian stocks ended sharply higher after a day of active trading that saw Banco Ganadero carve out impressive gains in Bogota and Medellin.

Medellin's IBOMED general price closed up 0.68 percent at 13,524.66 on a larger-than-average trading volume of 3.2 billion shares. Bogota's IBB index ended up 1.75 percent, meanwhile, closing at 876.35. Volume in Bogota was also 3.2 billion pesos.

The days's biggest gainer by far was Banco Ganadero, whose preferential shares jumped 11.3 percent in Medellin to close at 223 pesos per share. "The rise was due to demand by foreign funds," one broker said.
